subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After the requester completion turn has run without required message-tool evidence, should OpenClaw record terminal visible-delivery failure, or must it add a separately persisted delivery-only retry operation?
rationale: Both choices avoid replaying requester orchestration, but they establish different permanent message-delivery guarantees and persistence behavior; the repository does not currently provide a delivery-only operation that makes the retry choice mechanical.

options.title: Accept terminal failure
options.body: Keep this narrow replay-safe design, then require exact-head proof and PR-body alignment before merge.

options.title: Build delivery-only retry
options.body: Persist enough outbound delivery data to retry only the visible send without invoking the requester agent again.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep current behavior until agents owners define the requester-wake and visible-delivery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal failure
recommendation.body: Keep this narrow replay-safe design, then require exact-head proof and PR-body alignment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers the lifecycle, persisted registry state, and announce-delivery boundary requiring this decision.
